#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a 2-hour project kickoff meeting event for next Monday at 10:00 AM."""
import os
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, date

try:
    from icalendar import Calendar, Event, Alarm
    HAVE_ICALENDAR = True
except ImportError:
    HAVE_ICALENDAR = False

# --- Compute "next Monday" ---
# Monday = 0 ... Sunday = 6
today = date.today()
days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7  # today is Monday -> "next Monday" means a week from now
next_monday = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

# --- Local timezone from environment ---
local_tz = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
print(f"Today: {today} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Next Monday: {next_monday} ({next_monday.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Local timezone: {local_tz}")

summary = "Project Kickoff Meeting"
start = datetime(next_monday.year, next_monday.month, next_monday.day, 10, 0, 0,
                 tzinfo=local_tz)
end = start + timedelta(hours=2)

if HAVE_ICALENDAR:
    cal = Calendar()
    cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN")
    cal.add("version", "2.0")
    cal.add("calscale", "GREGORIAN")

    event = Event()
    event.add("uid", f"project-kickoff-{next_monday.isoformat()}@calendar-skill")
    event.add("dtstamp", datetime.now().astimezone())
    event.add("dtstart", start)
    event.add("dtend", end)
    event.add("summary", summary)
    event.add("description", "Kickoff meeting for the project. Agenda, goals, and "
                             "roles will be discussed.")
    event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
    event.add("transp", "OPAQUE")

    alarm = Alarm()
    alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
    alarm.add("description", f"{summary} starts in 15 minutes!")
    alarm.add("trigger", timedelta(minutes=-15))
    event.add_component(alarm)

    cal.add_component(event)
    content = cal.to_ical()
else:
    # Manual fallback ICS generation
    fmt = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S"
    dtstart = start.strftime(fmt)
    dtend = end.strftime(fmt)
    dtstamp = datetime.now().astimezone().strftime(fmt)
    content = (
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\n"
        "VERSION:2.0\r\n"
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN\r\n"
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN\r\n"
        "BEGIN:VEVENT\r\n"
        f"UID:project-kickoff-{next_monday.isoformat()}@calendar-skill\r\n"
        f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}\r\n"
        f"DTSTART:{dtstart}\r\n"
        f"DTEND:{dtend}\r\n"
        f"SUMMARY:{summary}\r\n"
        "DESCRIPTION:Kickoff meeting for the project. Agenda, goals, and roles "
        "will be discussed.\r\n"
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED\r\n"
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE\r\n"
        "BEGIN:VALARM\r\n"
        "ACTION:DISPLAY\r\n"
        "DESCRIPTION:Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes!\r\n"
        "TRIGGER:-PT15M\r\n"
        "END:VALARM\r\n"
        "END:VEVENT\r\n"
        "END:VCALENDAR\r\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")

out_path = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "project_kickoff.ics")
with open(out_path, "wb") as f:
    f.write(content)
print(f"Wrote {out_path} ({len(content)} bytes)")

# --- Validation ---
if HAVE_ICALENDAR:
    with open(out_path, "rb") as f:
        cal2 = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())
    for component in cal2.walk():
        if component.name == "VEVENT":
            print(f"Validated event: {component.get('summary')}")
            print(f"  Start: {component.get('dtstart').dt}")
            print(f"  End:   {component.get('dtend').dt}")
            print(f"  UID:   {component.get('uid')}")
else:
    print("Validation: manual ICS written (icalendar lib not available)")
